title: 第944章 抵达目的地悄然跟随第943章 被火兽王发现遭遇追杀
lines: “该死，竟然没有唬住这家伙！”
楚峰心中暗骂一声，随即将玉佩给捏碎。
一道虚幻的身影从玉佩中飞出，直奔那疾驰而来的火兽王。
正是谢晚晴的灵身！
楚峰瞥了一眼虚幻身影，随即转身朝着平原深处疾驰而去。
同时，体内造化灵力迅速覆盖全身，他的身形渐渐的隐入在了杂草丛中。
而谢晚晴的灵身也与那一头火兽王激烈的战斗在了一起。
砰砰砰。
四周的灌木和杂草顿时被双方的战斗余波卷起撕碎。
不过眨眼间，这里的地面变得光秃秃的。
道台境强者的战斗余波继续朝着远处传播而去。
原本已经放缓了脚步的安崇和安若惜两人不由得停下脚步，转身看向远方的空中。
“是苏少之前拿出的底牌！”
安若惜看着远方空中那模糊的两道身影。
虽然看不真切，但能勉强看得出来，与火兽王战斗的应该是一位女子。
“少，小姐，我们还是先离开吧，苏少的底牌乃是一位强者的灵力分身，坚持不了多久……”
安崇说道。
“嗯，我们先过去吧，他们应该也快要跟上来了……”
安若惜一改之前的温和，双眼之中闪烁着锐利的目光。
紧接着，两人身形一闪，消失在了灌木丛中。
另一边，尸魂宗的三人在胖子和瘦子的带领下，与剩余的那些火兽相遇。
双方再度爆发了一场大战。
但尸魂宗的三人凭借强大的实力和三具道台境的尸傀，将一众火兽杀的四散而逃。
“吼吼吼！”
似乎是感知到了自己属下死伤众多，那一头火兽王仰天大吼，喷出火焰终于将谢晚晴的灵身给硬生生的拖着消耗完毕了。
等它回到火兽群时，已不足三十头火兽了。
随即，他带着剩余的火兽循着尸魂宗几人留下的气息追了过去。
楚峰隐身在茂密的草丛中急速穿行，不知道过了多久，终于从杂草丛中逃了出来。
此刻，天边已经泛出一丝白光，天即将亮起来。
“呼，前辈，它没有追来吧？”
楚峰喘着粗气问道。
“没有！”
听到确切的回答，楚峰不由得瘫坐在地上。
“没想到这么快就用到了神女殿下的灵身……”
楚峰不禁摇了摇头。
content_en:
"Damn it, I didn't scare this guy!"
Chu Feng cursed secretly in his heart and then crushed the jade pendant into pieces.
An illusory figure flew out of the jade pendant and headed straight for the speeding Fire Beast King.
It is Xie Wanqing’s spiritual body!
Chu Feng glanced at the illusory figure, then turned around and galloped towards the depths of the plain.
At the same time, the spiritual power of creation in his body quickly covered his whole body, and his figure gradually disappeared into the weeds.
Xie Wanqing's spiritual body also fought fiercely with the fire beast king.
Bang bang bang.
The surrounding bushes and weeds were suddenly swept up and torn apart by the aftermath of the battle between the two sides.
But in the blink of an eye, the ground here became bare.
The aftermath of the battle between the Daotai realm masters continued to spread towards the distance.
An Chong and An Ruoxi, who had already slowed down, couldn't help but stop and turned to look into the distant sky.
"It's the trump card that Mr. Su used before!"
An Ruoxi looked at the two blurry figures in the sky in the distance.
Although he couldn't see it clearly, he could barely tell that the one fighting the Fire Beast King should be a woman.
"Master, Miss, let's leave first. Master Su's trump card is the spiritual clone of a strong man. He won't be able to hold on for long..."
An Chong said.
"Well, let's go there first, they should be following soon..."
An Ruoxi changed her previous gentleness, and her eyes flashed with sharp eyes.
Immediately afterwards, the two men flashed and disappeared into the bushes.
On the other side, the three members of the Corpse Soul Sect, led by Fatty and Slim, met the remaining fire beasts.
A big battle broke out between the two sides again.
However, the three members of the Corpse Soul Sect relied on their powerful strength and the three corpse puppets of the Taoist realm to kill the fire beasts and scatter them in all directions.
"Ho ho ho!"
As if sensing the heavy casualties among his subordinates, the fire beast king roared to the sky, spouting flames and finally dragging and consuming Xie Wanqing's spiritual body.
When it returned to the fire beast group, there were less than thirty fire beasts.
Immediately, he took the remaining fire beasts and chased after them following the auras left by the Soul Sect members.
Chu Feng hid himself in the dense grass and quickly ran through it. After an unknown amount of time, he finally escaped from the weeds.
At this moment, there was a trace of white light on the horizon, and the sky was about to light up.
"Huh, senior, it's not chasing you, is it?"
Chu Feng asked breathlessly.
"No!"
After hearing the exact answer, Chu Feng couldn't help but slumped on the ground.
"I didn't expect that Her Highness the Goddess's spiritual body would be used so soon..."
Chu Feng couldn't help but shook his head.
title_en: Chapter 944: Arrive at the destination and follow quietly Chapter 943: Discovered by the Fire Beast King and chased
